title: MarketSync: Copy Telegram Signals Into MT4/MT5, Automatically
excerpt: Automate Telegram-to-MetaTrader copying with per-account risk controls, full logs and account analytics. Cloud-based, no VPS.
content_html:
MarketSync reads the channels, groups and forum topics you already follow, uses AI to analyse every signal in any language, applies your per-account risk rules, and executes into MetaTrader, logging the whole journey from message to fill. Cloud-based. No VPS.

The Telegram-to-MetaTrader copier, explained.

MarketSync is a cloud-based order-routing tool that automatically copies trading signals from Telegram into MetaTrader 4 and 5 accounts. It analyses each qualifying signal, applies your per-account risk rules and symbol mapping, routes the trade in real time, and logs every step from message to execution. It is not a broker, signal provider or financial adviser, and it does not provide trading advice or guarantee results.

Frequently asked questions

What does MarketSync actually do?

MarketSync reads the Telegram sources you select, analyses qualifying trading signals, applies each account's copy and risk rules, and routes the trades to your connected MetaTrader 4 or 5 accounts, logging every step from message to execution.

Is MarketSync a broker or signal provider?

No. MarketSync is not a broker, signal provider, financial adviser or investment manager. You bring your own signal sources, broker, accounts and risk settings. MarketSync is the automation and intelligence layer that executes and tracks them.

Do I need a VPS to keep it running?

No. MarketSync runs in the cloud. Once your Telegram sources and MetaTrader accounts are connected, copying continues without your computer or a VPS being switched on.

Can I control risk per account?

Yes. Each account has its own lot sizing, daily loss limit, max open trades, symbol restrictions, slippage tolerance and a one-switch pause. That is especially useful for funded and prop-firm accounts with strict rules.

Will it help me pass a prop-firm challenge?

MarketSync does not guarantee that you pass any challenge. It gives you tools to copy consistently, control symbols and lot sizes, cap drawdown and monitor performance. The trading decisions and results remain yours.

How do I pay?

By card or crypto. Plans are Starter (Monthly) and Elite (Yearly), and you can add extra MetaTrader accounts as add-ons. You can change plan from Settings → Billing & Plans.

Which platforms are supported?

MarketSync supports MetaTrader 4 and MetaTrader 5 today. Cross-platform copying for cTrader, DXtrade and TradeLocker, plus MT-to-MT copy trading, are on the roadmap.

Does it work if my group posts in another language?

Yes. Signals are analysed by AI, so channels, groups and forum topics posting in Arabic, Hindi, Urdu, Spanish, Russian or any other language are read the same way as English ones, including follow-up updates and close commands.
